AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, suggesting it might be inactive or malfunctioning.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage to prevent potential performance degradation or system instability.
Evaluate and potentially restart or reconfigure AI systems to ensure they are actively learning and generating opportunities.
Review trading strategies and market conditions to ensure they are aligned with current market dynamics and capable of executing trades.

recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system slowdowns or failures, impacting trading operations and user experience.

recommendations.action: Restart or debug the AI system to ensure it resumes normal operation and starts generating learning cycles and opportunities.
